title: Ongoing DevOps
meta: A first round of updates, patches and checks on your servers, with a routine your team can follow. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Ongoing DevOps, starting with a first care round
overview: Servers need regular care: operating system updates, security patches, certificate and disk checks, backup tests and log review. We run a first full care round on your set-up, fix what we find and write a routine you can repeat. If you would like us to keep doing it every month, we quote that separately once we have seen what your set-up needs.

faq: No. It is a fixed-price first care round, paid once. Monthly DevOps care is quoted separately, with response times and checks listed before you commit.
Most updates do not. Those that need a restart, such as kernel updates, are planned for a quiet time that we agree with you in advance. We take a backup first and check the system afterwards.
What if you find a big problem?
We tell you the same day, explain the risk in plain words and suggest the fix. Small fixes are part of the round. Larger ones, such as a full migration, can be a separate order.
Which operating systems do you cover?
Ubuntu, Debian, Amazon Linux, Rocky and similar Linux systems, plus Docker hosts. Windows servers can often be covered too. Tell us what you run in the form and we confirm before starting.
